t: Montagu House in Whitehall was the town house built by John Montagu, the second Duke of Montagu, whose country seat was Boughton House in Northamptonshire. Later it became a home of the Dukes of Buccleuch. The sixth Duke was born and died here, and his son, the seventh Duke, was also born here. His daughter, Princess Alice, Duchess of Gloucester, who married the third son of George the Fifth, was born here too, as was Lord Herbert Scott. Viscount Hampden died here.
